==Description==
'''PVP_4''' was a test [[Maps|map]] for [[PVP Test]].

==Design & Path==
'''PVP_4''' was a map split into two parts. These parts were identical, except one was colored red while the other was blue, and the sides were flipped. It was a basic baseplate with multiple cliffs on it, though none of them actually counted as cliff spots. There was a large brick next to one of the loops, which acted as a cliff. The path for this map starts at one edge of the map and ends at another. 

The path goes straight and turns right, entering the first loop. After leaving the first loop, the path is straight before taking a turn to the left into the second loop. After leaving the second loop, the path is straight until it reaches the exit.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:PVPVar4}}

==Strategy==
*The loops on this map benefit short ranged towers like the [[Paintballer]], [[Shotgunner]] or [[Gladiator]] greatly, as enemies will loop around, allowing these towers to attack them multiple times.
**The loops that appear on this map are also great spots for the [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]], due to them matching their circle flight paths.
*Support towers should be placed in a way that covers both loops, for towers placed outside and inside the loop.
*The layout of this map allows towers that can damage multiple enemies at a time to be quite effective, as enemies will tend to occupy the same space often.

==Trivia==
*The intermission lobby lists SorenDerg as one of the creators. However, they were not actually involved in creating this map and have not even been active in the Tower Defense Simulator community since early 2023.
